(343)blo sbyong gi sa bon bzhugs so/chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams dang*/dbyer med lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/'di tsam ma yin tshe rabs

tei:div.tei:p: (343)blo sbyong gi sa bon bzhugs so/ chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams dang*/ dbyer med lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ 'di tsam ma yin tshe rabs thams cad kyi/ skyabs su khyed brten thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs/ zhes mchod par brjod pa sngon du song nas/ da ris nyams len chos rnams kyi rtsa ba/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ ces blo ldog rnam pa bzhi'i rang gi rgyud yang nas yang du sbyong bas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang tshe mi rtag pa gnyis bsam nas tshe 'di'i 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la zhen pa'i blo ldog nas/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang las rgyu 'bras kyi gnas la bsam pas phyi ma'i 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la zhen pa ldog nges par 'byung nas thar ba'i go 'phang don du gnyer zhing*/ thar ba rang gi rang gar sgrub mi shes pas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid nga ldan pa zhig gis ston pa las khyi dang glo ba 'aprad pa bzhin du su thug thug gang byung (344)byung gis mi chog par brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan zhing man ngag gi gnad dang ldan pa re bston pa gal che/ de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing nyams len gnad du 'gro ba la blo ldog rnam pa bzhis rgyud ma 'byongs bar stong pa kha khyer gyi rtogs ldan/ las 'bras khyad gsod gyi grub thob/ mi sngon btsun tshug gi bya bral/ chos brgyad zhe bzhag gi chos pa ltar snang gi g.yeng bas khyer na don med pas/ ral pa'i ma yin dbyug pas min/ gsungs pa bzhin/ rang btsong ngo tsha med pa'i rgyu 'bras khyad gsod kyi chos pa yin zer ba deng song gi dus su mang rab zhig snang ba'i rjes rgyug ma byed/ dang po dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che rgyu dpe grags gsum gyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba zhig da ris thob pa 'di skye ba sngon mar tshul khrims srung*/ sbyin sogs dge ba'i bsags rgyab mang pos grogs byed/

rkyen smon lam rnam par dag pa'i 'bras bus thob na/ snga ma gang byas da lta'i lus la ltos/ zhes pa bzhin (345)thob pa yin pas/ da phyin chad dal 'byor gyi lus rten khyad par can rnyed rgyu rang gi rgyud la brtags na/ phyi ma gar 'gro rang gi las la rag zhes pas dal ba thob pa'i rgyu tshul khrims rtsi bsrung*/ 'byor ba thob pa'i rgyu yar dkon mchog la mchod pa ci byed/ mar ngan slong la sbyin pa ci btang la brtags na sdom pa gsum gyi tshul khrims srung nas dal ba thob pa'i rten du rung ba shin tu dka' bas/ rig 'jin 'jigs med gling pas/ srung mtshams mi shes srung bar rlom pa mtshar/ gsungs pa bzhin lam kha'i khyi sdom bzhin du gang rnyed kyi zas za/ gang byung gi gnas su 'dug su byung gi grogs dang 'grogs nas/ rnyed rlom grong chog gi nyi ma shor na 'chi khar 'gyod pa yis gdung bas/ de lta bus mi phan par/ gu ru rin po ches/ rnyed par dga' ba u dum wā ra dang*/ rnyed pa don chen yid bzhin nor bur mtshungs/ gsungs pa bzhin/ yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams (346)rta kha srab kyis bsgyur ba lta bu'i dus tshod 'di na dge sdig spongs len zhig bgyis na/ legs na thar ba'i gru gzing lus 'di yin/ nyes na 'khor ba'i gting rdo lus 'di yin/ ces dge ba zhig sgrub na yar 'gro'i sa mtshams/ tshe stod pas tshe smad bde/ de bas 'chi kha dang bar do bde nas bde ba'i gnas su skye ba gong 'phel du 'gro mi dge ba sgrub na tshe stod pas tshe smad de bas 'chi kha dang bar do nas ngan song ngan 'gro mu mtha' med par 'khyams 'gro bas/ bsam gzhig legs par brtags nas da lta skyid sdug gang gi sgo nas 'jin bsam na rang gi lag khar yod pas mi dge ba spang*/ dge ba sgrub/ dal 'byor la snying po lon nges zhig mi byed ro snyams nas/ 'di snang la mgo mi 'khor yid mi chags par bsam rgyu chos las med pas/

dran rgyu chos las med pa/ byed rgyu chos ma gtogs med pa zhig gi bar du blo sbyong dgos/ dal 'byor la snying po lon zer na/ lus ngag yid gsum dge ba'i lam du dran shes bzhin bag (347)yod gsum gyi skya bar thon pa sems rgyud 'gyur nges pa zhig byed pa yin/ de min par rang gi chos sgrub pa mi la ngom rgyu yod pa/ mis blta na mthong rgyu bshad rgyu yod pa zhig byed bsam tshar na 'jin rten chos brgyad kyi bdud kyis khyer ba'i ltar snang bcos ma'i chos par ma song ba zhig ci nas gnad gal che rung*/ da dus dbang gi kha lta mthon po/ lta rgyu bsgom rgyu med/ dge bas phan mi 'dogs/ sdig pas gnod mi bskyal/ phyi chad thod pa mgo la mi 'gel zer nas spang dgos rgyu'i mi dge ba mi spang/ dgos rgyu'i dge ba dang du mi len par kha pho ci cher sgrogs/ spyod pa khyi las dman/ 'di phyi rgyu 'bras gnas la 'chol nyog tu spyod nas/ skye 'chi bar do'i 'gag la thugs dus sems can rang ga ba las dman pa rnams kyi rjes rgyug ma byed/ gnyis pa 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa ni/ de ltar rnyed dka'i dal 'byor la snying po zhig len dgos snyam pa yod (348)kyang 'chi ba mi rtag pa 'di bsam nas rgyud la ma skyes na chos sang byang dang gnang bya'i ngang du mi tshe stong zad du 'chor bas/ mi rtag pa 'di thun re re gnyis re'am lo re zla re tsam la bsam pas ji bzhin mi 'ong dper na mjo pho rkang chad lag rdum la sman thun re re gnyis res phan pa med pa bzhin mi rtag pa bsam kyang yun tung ngu'i rgyud 'gyur bar dka'abs gsar snying gi mkhas grub ris med pa rnams kyi gdams ngag mthun par/ rtsa ba gsum/ de re re la rgyu mtshan gsum gsum gyi steng dgu'i sgo nas nyams su len pa la/ rtsa ba nges par 'chi ba la/ skyes nas ma shi bar mi tshe los zad/ lo zla ba zhag za ma dus skad cig ma re re bzhin tshe zad nas 'chi ba nyi ma nub rer phyogs pa'am chu phran rgya mtsho la bsnyegs pa bzhin du rang gi tshe 'jad pas nges par 'chi/

de la rgyu mtshan gsum ste/ 'chi bdag nges par 'ong ba la sman dang sngags dang rim 'gro bcud len la sogs pa thabs gang gi rkyen gyis bzlog du med pas nges par 'chi (349)ba bsam/ gnyis pa tshe la snon pa med cing 'grib byed bar ma chad du yod pas ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing su mthil rdol ba'am/ 'bras bu'i bang mjod bcus pa bzhin nges par 'chi ba bsam/ gsum pa da lta gson po'i skabs na mi tshe phyod gnyid du zad/ de'i phyed kyi sum cha gcig byis pa'i dus kyis zad/ sum cha gcig g.yeng bas khyer/ sum cha gcig rgas pas mnar bas chos bya ba'i long med par nges pas 'chi ba ste/ dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyi log pa las/ pad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che/ gsungs pa bzhin bsam mo/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa nam 'chi cha med pa ma bsam na/ nges par 'chi snyam pa tsam zhig yod kyang*/ da dung mi 'chi bsam nas sems gyis mi 'chi ba'i phyogs kho na bzung nas chos mi 'grub pas nam 'chi nges med bsam dgos pas nam 'chi nges pa yod dgos na/ de bzhin gshegs pa lta bu'i tshad ma'i skyes bu zhig gis tshe tshad (350)bzhag pa'am/ yangan rang nyid la zag med kyi mngon shes zhig yod pas shes pam/ yang na gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po dang gnyen bshes bzang po zhig bsgrig nas da dung mi 'chi snyam pa'i gdeng gsum po med par/ sngon gyi tshe'i 'phen pa dge ba'i las mar me'i snum/ skyes bu'i mthob shugs lta bu nam zad mi shes pas/ de ring ngam sang nyin dang zla ba phyi ma'ang lo phyi ma gang snga mi shes pas nam 'chi nges pa med pa dang gar skye nges pa med pa bsam/ de la rgyu mtshan gsum/ spyir 'jam bu gling pa'i tshe la nges pa med pas nam 'chi nges pa med/ gnyis pa gson pa'i rkyen nyung zhing zas gos gnas mal yo byad thams cad 'chi ba'i rkyen du 'gyur pa la bsam na nam 'chi nges pa med/ gsum pa lus nyams chung ba nam gzhug gi sbrang bu lta bu nyams chung bas nam 'chi nges pa med pa'o/

rtsa ba'i gsum pa 'chi ba'i dus gang gis mi phan te/ 'jam bu gling gi rgyu rdzas longs spyod thams cad mi gcig la yod kyang 'chi ba'i nang (351)par khab skud pa tsam khyer dbang med par tha na gces par bskyang ba'i lus 'di yang bzhag nas phyi ma'i lam so cher gcer bu lag stong mchan du bcug nas 'gro ba la/ dam pa'i chos ma gtogs gang gis mi phanya par 'chi khar phan gnod dge sdig gnyis las med pas sdig par bshags pa dang phyin chad sdom sems dge ba cho phra ci 'grub nas brtson 'grus bskyed dgos/ de la rgyu mtshan gsum/ lus kyis mi phan/ longs spyod mi mi phan/ gnyen bshes kyis mi phan te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ pha khu tshangs pa brgya byin yod kyang mi phan/ mja' grogs lha phran stong phrag yod kyang mi phan/ srid sde lha minadamags dpung yod kyang mi phan gsungs pa bzhin bsam mo/ des na 'chi ba mi rtag pa 'di kho na bsam nas chos gsha' ma zhig sgrub pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen su to ba'i slob ma byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa lnga brgya byung ba gdams pa 'di zab pa lags/ blo la (352)yar skyod med pa'i/ chos la yar skyod gang mthor btang bas phan pa med pas/ rang rgyud la rtog dpyod zhib du 'tshal lo/ gsum pa sdug bsngal shes par bya ba 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa ni/ phung po lnga'i rigs 'dra bar mi chad par byung ba 'di 'khor ba yin la/ de'i chos ngan song gsum sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ mtho ris lha dang mi gnyis 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khams gong ma gnyis na khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i khams gsum po me'i 'obs/ srin mo'i gling*/ mtshon cha'i dbal ltar sdug bsngal las ma 'das pas zhib tu rigs drug po re re zhing*/ gnas dang lus dang sdug bsngal dang tshe tshad bcas zhib tu bsam nas sems sdug lhang nge ba'i skyo shas dang*/ de las thar nas zhi ba don gnyer gyi nges 'byung bskyed par shog

bzhi pa kun 'byung spang bar bya ba las rgyu 'bras gyi khrid bsam par bya ba la/ spang bya mi dge ba'i las/ sgrub bya dge ba'i las gnyis/ mi dge ba bcu po spang na sdom pa thams cad (353)kyi gnad 'gag tshang bas/ lus ngag gi mi dge bdun po re re nas/ gzhi bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug bzhi re tshang na sdig pa'i yan lag chen po rdzogs pa dang*/ mthar thug ma tshang na sdig pa'i yan lag 'bring po dang*/ gzhi bsam gnyis tshang na me long la gzungs brnyan gyi gos tshar ba bzhin du rang rgyud sdig pas gos tshar ba yin pas/ dang po sdig pa'i las lam che 'bring chung gsum gyi rdzogs tshul/ de nas 'bras bu rnam smin gyi myong tshul re 'ga' rgyu 'bras gnyis re re nas lto sbyar te bsam/ yid kyi mi dge ba gsum gzhi bsam gnyis kyi sdig pa'i yan lag rjogs tshul dang rnam smamin bzhi bsam/ de nas dge ba la yang de bzhin bsam bzhig btang*/ thun mtshams su/ mdo sde las brgya pa dang*/ dran pa gnyer bzhag gang po'i rtogs brjod la sogs las 'bras ston pa'i mdo rnams la lta rtogs byed/ mdor na/ mdo las/ las rnams kyang ni snang (354)tshogs pas/ de yi 'gro 'di sna tshogs byas/ sna tshogs rnam par 'khyams shing 'jug las kyi drwa ba 'di che'o/ zhes pas 'gro ba drug na/ gnas mi 'dra ba lus rten mi 'dra ba/ bde sdug dang tshe tshad 'dra mi 'dra sna tshogs pa 'di dag las rgyu 'bras sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis byung la khyad par da lta rang gi rgyud la dpag na nyi ma gcig la'ang bde sdug btang snyoms kyi tshor ba gsum rim par 'byung ba 'di yang sngon gyi dge ba'i las nyung ngu'i da lta bde ba'i tshor ba nyung ngu las myi myong*/ de bas sdig pa mang du bsags pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba mang du myong*/ phal cher bde min sdug min gyi btang snyoms pa'i las kyi 'bras bu bde min sdug min gyi tshor bas snga ma'i rgyu rnams rjes su dpog nus pas phyin chad bde ba 'ga' zhig gi rgyu dge ba kho na la brtson nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba spangs/

btang snyoms kyi rgyu btang snyoms kyi rtog pa dang las rnams dge ba'i lam du bcug nas rgyu 'bras la blang dor byed pa shin tu gal che/ dge bshes (355)phu chung bas/ gnas lugs don la ma grub kyang*/ rmi lam dus kyi rgyu 'bras bzhin/ 'khrul ngo'i rgyu 'bras mi bslu bas/ sdig spong dge la 'bod cagi aṃ/ gsungs pa bzhin blang dor ma nor ba re ma byed na/ dus phyis rtogs pa mthon par rlom pa rnams kyis spong dgos rgyu'i sdig pa mi dge ba ranams mi spong bar 'chol nyog tu spyod/ sgrub dgos rgyu'i dge ba'i tshogs rnams mi sgrub par/ 'khrul zhig dang bya btang du khas 'cho ba rnams kyi mig ltos ngan pa rnams kyi rjes su ma 'brang bar rang rgyud dam pa'i chos dang mthun nam 'gal snyam nas yang yang zhus dag brgyab na rang drin rang la che ba yin pas/ mdo las/ sdig pa dag dang dge ba la/ rang nyid rang gi dbang po yin/ rang nyid rang gi mgon yin gyi/ rang nyid rang gi skyabs su 'gyur/ zhes pa bzhin no/ dam pa'i zhal lung bdud rtsi theg pa 'dis/ nyon mongs rang rgyud tha ba nom byas nas/ tshul khrims (356)yon tan gzhi rten 'jin ma'i khams/ mngon rtogs rin chen nor gyis phyug par shog ces pa'ang g.yu khog bla ma rdo rje'i ngor chos smra ba tshul khrims rgya mtshos so/ dge'o/ bkra shis/// /
